purpose: Verify the retained natural duration wording in actual interrupted waypoint addition, with unchanged airport and office-correction controls.
hypotheses: Adding nearest coffee during the initial MG Road result preserves the destination and adds exactly the declared canonical stop.
The final waypoint result retains 13 minutes and zero extra minutes in text and received whole-stream ASR, with proper-name deviations reported separately.
Interrupted earlier handles stop, final results finish, all attempts remain recorded, and room/application/process cleanup are assessed separately from server job status.

waypoint.initial_input: Navigate to MG Road Metro Station.
waypoint.final_input: Add the nearest coffee as a stop.

correction.final_input: Actually, go to the office instead.

method: Four serial fresh rooms, one shared local stack, fixed waypoint/baseline/waypoint/correction order; no retries or exclusions.
Two new first-render production-voice inputs checked once by pinned ASR; old control WAVs copied exactly. Synthetic voice matches output voice, so no independent human-speech claim.
Existing driver correction label denotes the second input clip. Waypoint clips use that same observed-result PCM trigger for a stop-addition request, not a destination correction.
No source or configuration changes during a live suite; retain failed captures and all tool/error/runtime logs.
After each client exits, inspect only its owned room for agent presence for up to10seconds; do not delete the room to create apparent job cleanup.
Send worker SIGTERM after all trials and departure checks. Keep original20second outer grace and record any escalation separately from capture success.
Keep all raw trace equality failures, classifying initial-event omission and any events emitted after client disconnect separately.
Review full received audio through pinned local ASR after timed capture and owned-stack cleanup. This is an ASR proxy, not human listening.
limitations: Development cases chosen to exercise an observed duration failure, not held-out evaluation.
No controlled RTC before/after comparison or population latency claim.
Exact declared tool sequence is checked separately from semantic effects; preserve valid alternatives and every extra/failed/stale attempt.
No injected slow logger in these live cases; ordinary compute_route delay remains. Controlled loop fault injection is separate iteration6 evidence.
Capture completion, tool effects, full trace equality, received content, caller cleanup, room-job departure and process exit are separate checks.
Input/frame/data transport timestamps do not establish physical audible timing. Default ICE/STUN may use network services although all model inference is local.
Existing recorder may omit the initial listening event; its receiver shutdown does not prove every transmitted frame arrived.
offline_decision: Retain C: 20/20 expected minutes versus A18/20; B18/20 trades 13 repair for16 regression. No global speed change. See number-analysis.json for all guarded transcripts and costs.
